title: Leonida Trophy Atlas — GTA VI (PS5)
missable_rule: A trophy counts as missable when it is tied to one named story mission or a single one-off story beat. Story missions can usually be replayed, so a flag means do it when it comes up, not that it is gone for good.

source_legend.official: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: the official trophy names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them
source_legend.psn: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy guide: progress targets and counts
source_legend.advice: This atlas's own advice, read from the official description — not yet checked inside the game

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one follows on its own. Work the roadmap in order — story, strangers, activities, collectibles, then the money cleanup — and the platinum is the final pop.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It is the first mission of the game, so this trophy pops as soon as the opening wraps up.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 1 through to its end. Chapter trophies come from story progress alone, so keep following the story missions and this one pops at the chapter's close.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 2 through to its end. Keep following the story missions and it pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 3 through to its end. Keep following the story missions and it pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 4 through to its end. Keep following the story missions and it pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. This is a story trophy with a missable flag: play the finale when it comes and it pops at the end.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run. It is a single named story mission, so take it when it appears in the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. A single named story mission — take it when it appears.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. A single named story mission — take it when it appears.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. A single named story mission — take it when it appears.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. A single named story mission — take it when it appears.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. A single named story mission — take it when it appears.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the cleanup trophy: it pops when the last checklist item is done, so use the filters to find what is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts build up over normal play — jumps, near misses, airtime — so keep an eye on the count and grind the remainder with repeated jumps.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Sample everything the state offers — one go at each activity type is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. Practice each challenge until gold; the range lets you retry, so work through them one at a time.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Race each location until you win there, then move to the next.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — mix race types and locations until the total hits 20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take the challenge against Cal and out-fish him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade game and play it through to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's strand to its last mission — it is a single mission, so finish it when it comes.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's strand to its last mission and finish it when it comes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand to its last mission and finish it when it comes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Meet the strangers marked around the state and follow eight of their strands to the end.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand to its last mission and finish it when it comes.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's strand to its last mission and finish it when it comes.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Find each meditation spot and meditate there; work region by region so none is missed.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand until the unique-animal hunt appears, then take it down.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Gather cards across the state until three full sets are complete.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Tag WAiNK spots as you travel; the count builds up across the map.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges stack up across activities — keep playing and the total climbs to 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and escape.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Chain three shop robberies with your partner and keep the heat the whole way.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. New vehicles count on sight — drive around and the total climbs.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group enemies together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave the airport in a way the schedule did not plan — an improvised exit counts.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Deal with the Rhino tanks — take them on and survive the heat.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, stay out of sight, and leave without ever being spotted.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Hit five vaults and get clear each time.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop a truck, take it, and get clear.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Cover every area of the map — the count fills in as you travel.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. Hit one operation per gang, across all the gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the Ocean Beach spot, order the cocktail, and take in the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Break out of the showroom the loud way.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a round at the Kolt & Associates alley.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A partnership moment — play the story beat with your partner and it pops.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Choices count toward this one — keep deciding as the story asks.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Succeed on a second try — a retry that lands counts here.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange — keep an eye out for the odd and unexplained across Leonida.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee drive-by.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Feed marked bills through your contacts until the total hits $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend across the shops until the total hits $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property on the market.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register vehicles in the app until the total hits 10.
